notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.2 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
ULTRA CORE DIVE Update 1.0.2  

Fixed the issue when soft resetting the game ( whether it was through pause menu, or beating the game ) caused the achievement gates to crash the game. 

 Fixed some menu sounds 



There was also an emergency patch uploaded on June 22nd.  Incase you missed it here are the notes for that:  

Fixed the issue where the upgrade randomizer "runs out of upgrades" and crashes the game.

 Changed some terminology on some of the upgrades  

Added more special weapon containers on the last zone  



Thank you for your patience!
